q: 中心厂现在的进水流量是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.inflow_m3h AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.inflow_m3h AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 查中心厂最近30分钟内最新一条原始监测数据，取进水瞬时流量作为当前值。

q: 当前各厂好氧区溶解氧分别是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_1 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_2 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_1 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, ROUND(CAST(r.do_aerobic_2 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 取各厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据，展示好氧区1号、2号溶解氧。

q: 协税镇现在的污泥浓度MLSS是多少？

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.mlss AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 按厂站名称模糊匹配协税镇，从实时表 plant_reading 取最近半小时内最新一条 MLSS 读数。

q: 中心厂1号鼓风机现在的电流是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.current_a AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.current_a AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 按设备编码 P01-BL-1 查最近 30 分钟内的最新一条监测记录，取当前电流值。

q: 现在哪个厂的出水总氮最高？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.tn_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.tn_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '30 MINUTES' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 取各厂最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的出水总氮，按厂站去重后列出最新值（可再按总氮排序即可看出哪个厂最高）。

q: 昨天全区一共处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200
explanation: 对昨天整日全区所有厂站的每小时处理水量求和得到昨日总处理水量。

q: 中心厂昨天鼓风机一共耗电多少度？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 按昨天自然日区间汇总中心厂小时表鼓风机功率（每小时即耗电量），得到全天总耗电量。

q: 本周到目前为止各厂分别处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 从本周一零点起按厂站汇总小时处理水量。

q: 10月30日到11月4日这6天，梁山镇平均每天处理多少水？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.inflow_m3h) / 6) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均日处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '6 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.inflow_m3h) / 6) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均日处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '6 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计梁山镇污水处理站10月30日至11月4日6天的总处理水量，再除以6得到平均每天处理水量。

q: 昨天中心厂出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的日均值

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_out) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 出水COD均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷均值, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_out) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 出水COD均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷均值, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选名称含“中心”的厂站，取昨天自然日（0点至今日0点）小时均值表各出水指标的日均值，并附带处理水量。

q: 今天上午中心厂进水COD的平均值是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_in) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '6 HOURS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '12 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.cod_in) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '6 HOURS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '12 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 按“上午=06:00–12:00”筛选中心厂今日该时段的进水COD小时均值并取平均。

q: 过去24小时各厂的平均进水氨氮

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.nh3n_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 按厂站统计最近24小时小时表进水氨氮的均值，并保留两位小数。

q: 昨天全区鼓风机总耗电量和吨水曝气电耗是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200
explanation: 汇总昨天（前一自然日）全部厂站的小时鼓风机功率得总耗电量，处理水量取 inflow_m3h 之和，两者相除得吨水曝气电耗。

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.carbon_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.pac_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 昨天的最高气温和最低气温分别是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最低气温, ROUND(CAST(MAX(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最高气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最低气温, ROUND(CAST(MAX(temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最高气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计昨天自然日内的气象气温最低值和最高值。

q: 过去7天各厂的平均污泥浓度

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, ROUND(CAST(MIN(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最低值, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最高值 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, ROUND(CAST(MIN(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最低值, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.mlss) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 最高值 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 小时均值表无 MLSS 字段，故用原始表 plant_reading 按厂站求过去 7 天 mlss 的均值、最小值和最大值。

q: 昨天中心厂好氧区平均曝气风量是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AS 统计日期, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.air_flow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AS 统计日期, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.air_flow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选中心厂昨天自然日内的小时数据，对小时平均曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。

q: 11月3日协税镇每小时的出水总磷均值

sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(h.tp_out AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ORDER BY h.hour LIMIT 200
explanation: 按 11 月 3 日自然日范围筛选协税镇污水站的小时聚合数据，逐小时输出出水总磷均值。

q: 今天每小时全区的处理水量

attempt_details.sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour LIMIT 200
explanation: 按整点小时分组汇总全区所有厂站 plant_reading_1h 的小时处理水量，取今天 0 点到现在。

q: 本周每天中心厂的吨水曝气电耗

attempt_details.sql: SELECT CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour)) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour)) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
explanation: 按本周每天汇总中心厂的鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，二者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量立方米 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(r.inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 3
explanation: 按昨天自然日范围汇总各厂站小时表的进水流量（即处理水量），降序取前三名。

q: 过去7天各厂吨水碳源投加量（kg/m³）从高到低排列

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.carbon_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.carbon_dose_kgh) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 按厂站汇总最近7天碳源投加量（sum(carbon_dose_kgh)，kg）与处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)，m³），两者相除得吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。

q: 过去7天出水COD最高的那个小时是哪个厂、什么时间、多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(h.cod_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(h.cod_out AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
explanation: 查询最近7天小时均值数据，按出水COD降序取最高的一小时，并关联厂站名称。

q: 过去7天哪一天全区处理水量最大？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', hour) AS DATE) AS "日期", ROUND(CAST(SUM(inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(m³)" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', hour) AS DATE) AS "日期", ROUND(CAST(SUM(inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(m³)" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 按天汇总最近7天全区各厂站小时处理水量，取总量最大的一天。

q: 本周吨水曝气电耗最低的两个厂

attempt_details.sql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT r.plant_id, p.name AS plant_name, SUM(r.blower_kw) AS blower_kwh, SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS inflow_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY r.plant_id, p.name HAVING SUM(r.inflow_m3h) > 0) SELECT plant_name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST((blower_kwh / inflow_m3) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)" FROM weekly ORDER BY blower_kwh / inflow_m3 ASC LIMIT 2

sql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT r.plant_id, p.name AS plant_name, SUM(r.blower_kw) AS blower_kwh, SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS inflow_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY r.plant_id, p.name HAVING SUM(r.inflow_m3h) > 0) SELECT plant_name AS 厂站名称, ROUND(CAST((blower_kwh / inflow_m3) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)" FROM weekly ORDER BY blower_kwh / inflow_m3 ASC LIMIT 2
explanation: 按本周整点小时数据汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水曝气电耗并取最低的两个厂。

q: 过去7天有哪些厂出现过出水氨氮超标？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(pr.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, TO_CHAR(MAX(pr.hour), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND pr.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(pr.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, TO_CHAR(MAX(pr.hour), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND pr.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计最近7天内小时均值表中出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并汇总超标小时数、最高值和最近超标时间。

q: 11月4日黄官镇氨氮超标了几个小时？最高到了多少？

attempt_details.sql: WITH day_range AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AS start_ts, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS end_ts) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮_mgL FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id CROSS JOIN day_range AS d WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.hour >= d.start_ts AND r.hour < d.end_ts GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

sql: WITH day_range AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AS start_ts, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS end_ts) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮_mgL FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id CROSS JOIN day_range AS d WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.hour >= d.start_ts AND r.hour < d.end_ts GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 查询黄官镇污水站11月4日小时均值数据，按出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时计数，并取当日最高值。

q: 本周全区出水总磷超标的小时数一共有多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND tp_out_max > 0.5 LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND tp_out_max > 0.5 LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计本周以来所有厂站小时均值数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的小时记录数。

q: 昨天每个厂各有几个小时出水不达标？没有超标的厂也要列出来

attempt_details.sql: WITH bad AS (SELECT plant_id, COUNT(*) AS bad_hours FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND (cod_out > 50 OR nh3n_out_max > 5 OR tn_out > 15 OR tp_out_max > 0.5 OR ss_out > 10) GROUP BY plant_id) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COALESCE(b.bad_hours, 0) AS 出水超标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN bad AS b ON b.plant_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: WITH bad AS (SELECT plant_id, COUNT(*) AS bad_hours FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND (cod_out > 50 OR nh3n_out_max > 5 OR tn_out > 15 OR tp_out_max > 0.5 OR ss_out > 10) GROUP BY plant_id) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COALESCE(b.bad_hours, 0) AS 出水超标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN bad AS b ON b.plant_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 以昨天整日的小时均值数据按厂统计任一指标（COD>50、氨氮最大值>5、总氮>15、总磷最大值>0.5、SS>10）超标的小时数，并用 LEFT JOIN 保证未超标厂也列出为 0。

q: 协税镇本周第一次出现总磷超标是什么时候？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS "厂站", pr.hour AS "首次超标时间", ROUND(CAST(pr.tp_out_max AS DECIMAL), 3) AS "出水总磷最大值(mg/L)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND pr.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND pr.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY pr.hour ASC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT p.name AS "厂站", pr.hour AS "首次超标时间", ROUND(CAST(pr.tp_out_max AS DECIMAL), 3) AS "出水总磷最大值(mg/L)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND pr.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND pr.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY pr.hour ASC LIMIT 1
explanation: 按本周（周一起）筛选协税镇小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准 0.5 mg/L 的记录，按时间升序取第一条，即本周首次超标时刻。

q: 过去7天振动值最大的鼓风机是哪台？最大振动是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(MAX(dr.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND dr.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY MAX(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(MAX(dr.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND dr.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY MAX(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 筛选过去7天鼓风机的设备监测数据，按设备分组取最大振动值并倒序取第一台。

q: 11月4日黄官镇1号鼓风机停机了多少分钟？（设备数据每分钟一条）

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT dr.running) AS 停机分钟数 FROM plant AS p JOIN device AS d ON d.plant_id = p.id JOIN device_reading AS dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官镇%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND dr.ts < CAST('2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name, d.code LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, COUNT(r.ts) AS 监测点数, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均轴承温度_摄氏度, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高温度_摄氏度, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均振动_mms FROM device AS d JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN device_reading AS r ON r.device_id = d.id AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200

q: 昨天中心厂两台提升泵运行时的平均电流分别是多少？

q: 过去7天降雨强度最大的那一天，全区处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: WITH daily_rain AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS day, CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL) AS rain_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND ts < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1), max_day AS (SELECT day, rain_mm FROM daily_rain ORDER BY rain_mm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, ROUND(m.rain_mm, 1) AS 日降雨量_毫米, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 全区处理水量_立方米 FROM max_day AS m JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON DATE_TRUNC('DAY', r.hour) = m.day GROUP BY m.day, m.rain_mm LIMIT 200

sql: WITH daily_rain AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS day, CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL) AS rain_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND ts < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1), max_day AS (SELECT day, rain_mm FROM daily_rain ORDER BY rain_mm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, ROUND(m.rain_mm, 1) AS 日降雨量_毫米, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 全区处理水量_立方米 FROM max_day AS m JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON DATE_TRUNC('DAY', r.hour) = m.day GROUP BY m.day, m.rain_mm LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷最高值_mgL, TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 统计日期 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 昨天全区的处理水量比前天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS today), s AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < b.today THEN inflow_m3h END) AS yesterday_m3, SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < b.today - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN inflow_m3h END) AS before_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h, b) SELECT ROUND(CAST(yesterday_m3 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 昨天处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(before_m3 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 前天处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((yesterday_m3 - before_m3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 增加水量_m3 FROM s LIMIT 200

sql: WITH b AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS today), s AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < b.today THEN inflow_m3h END) AS yesterday_m3, SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < b.today - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN inflow_m3h END) AS before_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h, b) SELECT ROUND(CAST(yesterday_m3 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 昨天处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(before_m3 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 前天处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((yesterday_m3 - before_m3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 增加水量_m3 FROM s LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天平均进水COD高于全区平均水平的厂站有哪些？

attempt_details.sql: WITH plant_avg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(r.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.cod_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cod_in) AS avg_all FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND cod_in IS NOT NULL) SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(pa.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 过去7天平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(o.avg_all AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM plant_avg AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.avg_cod > o.avg_all ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200

sql: WITH plant_avg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(r.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.cod_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cod_in) AS avg_all FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND cod_in IS NOT NULL) SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(pa.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 过去7天平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(o.avg_all AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM plant_avg AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.avg_cod > o.avg_all ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 按厂站统计过去7天小时表进水COD均值，并与同期全区总平均比较，筛出高于全区平均的厂站。

q: 过去7天中心厂处理水量占全区的百分比

q: 过去7天各厂的总氮去除率（百分比）

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS q, SUM(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_in_load, SUM(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_out_load FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.inflow_m3h IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(q AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量m3, ROUND(CAST((tn_in_load / NULLIF(q, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 进水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST((tn_out_load / NULLIF(q, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST(((tn_in_load - tn_out_load) / NULLIF(tn_in_load, 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM t ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS q, SUM(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_in_load, SUM(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_out_load FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.inflow_m3h IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(q AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量m3, ROUND(CAST((tn_in_load / NULLIF(q, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 进水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST((tn_out_load / NULLIF(q, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮均值, ROUND(CAST(((tn_in_load - tn_out_load) / NULLIF(tn_in_load, 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM t ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 取最近7天小时均值数据，按厂站以处理水量为权重计算进出水总氮负荷，得出各厂总氮去除率百分比。

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name HAVING SUM(h.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2
explanation: 统计本周各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之比（吨水曝气电耗），按升序取最低的两个厂。

q: 过去7天有哪些厂出现过出水氨氮超标？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 查询过去7天内出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并统计超标小时数和最高值。

q: 11月4日黄官镇氨氮超标了几个小时？最高到了多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 氨氮最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 氨氮最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选黄官镇污水站昨天（11月4日）的小时数据，按小时出水氨氮最大值统计超标小时数并取当日最高值。

q: 本周全区出水总磷超标的小时数一共有多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 总磷超标小时数, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER(WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 涉及厂站数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 总磷超标小时数, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER(WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 涉及厂站数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计本周以来全区所有厂站小时均值中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时数，并给出涉及厂站数与最高值。

q: 昨天每个厂各有几个小时出水不达标？没有超标的厂也要列出来

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(h.hour) AS 有数据小时数, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(h.hour) AS 有数据小时数, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 以 plant 为主表左连接昨天的小时数据，按一级A标准统计各厂出水任一项超标的小时数，无超标或无数据的厂也会列出（计为 0）。

explanation: 查询中心厂过去7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大值。

q: 协税镇本周第一次出现总磷超标是什么时候？

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 首次超标时间, ROUND(CAST(h.tp_out_max AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1

q: 过去7天振动值最大的鼓风机是哪台？最大振动是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均振动_mm_s, COUNT(*) AS 监测条数 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY MAX(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均振动_mm_s, COUNT(*) AS 监测条数 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY MAX(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: 统计最近7天各鼓风机振动最大值，按最大值降序取第一台。

q: 中心厂各台运行中的鼓风机过去24小时的平均温度

q: 10月31日的降雨从几点开始、几点结束？

sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨开始时间, TO_CHAR(MAX(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨结束时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 累计降雨量_mm, COUNT(*) AS 有效记录数 FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND rain_mm_h > 0 LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS "10月31日处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS "10月30日处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS "比前一天增加_m3" FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

q: 过去7天降雨强度最大的那一天，全区处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: WITH rain_day AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS DATE) AS 日期, MAX(rain_mm_h) AS 最大降雨强度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 最大降雨强度 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT r.日期 AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(r.最大降雨强度 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM rain_day AS r LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) = r.日期 GROUP BY r.日期, r.最大降雨强度 ORDER BY r.日期 LIMIT 200

sql: WITH rain_day AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS DATE) AS 日期, MAX(rain_mm_h) AS 最大降雨强度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 最大降雨强度 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT r.日期 AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(r.最大降雨强度 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL)) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM rain_day AS r LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) = r.日期 GROUP BY r.日期, r.最大降雨强度 ORDER BY r.日期 LIMIT 200
explanation: 先找出过去7天内日最大降雨强度最高的一天，再汇总该日全区各厂站的小时处理水量。

q: 昨天全区的处理水量比前天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 前日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE -h.inflow_m3h END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 增加量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 前日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE -h.inflow_m3h END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 增加量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200
explanation: 分别汇总昨天与前天全区小时处理水量，并计算两者差值。

q: 过去7天平均进水COD高于全区平均水平的厂站有哪些？

attempt_details.sql: WITH plant_avg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name), district_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS') SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(pa.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST((SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM plant_avg AS pa WHERE pa.avg_cod > (SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg) ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200

sql: WITH plant_avg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name), district_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS') SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(pa.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST((SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM plant_avg AS pa WHERE pa.avg_cod > (SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg) ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 按厂站统计过去7天小时均值进水COD，并与同期全区平均进水COD比较，筛选高于全区平均的厂站。

q: 过去7天中心厂处理水量占全区的百分比

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER(WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER(WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 占比_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

sql: WITH h AS (SELECT h.plant_id, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS bad_hours FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY h.plant_id) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COALESCE(h.bad_hours, 0) AS 出水不达标小时数 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN h ON h.plant_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.status AS 状态 FROM device AS d JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200

q: 中心厂各台运行中的鼓风机过去24小时的平均温度

attempt_details.sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均温度_C FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' AND r.running AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.temp_c) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均温度_C FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' AND r.running AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选中心厂运行中的鼓风机，统计过去24小时运行监测数据的平均轴承温度。

q: 昨天中心厂两台提升泵运行时的平均电流分别是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.current_a) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均电流_A, COUNT(*) AS 运行采样点数 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.current_a) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均电流_A, COUNT(*) AS 运行采样点数 FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选中心厂提升泵昨天处于运行状态的监测记录，按设备编码分组求平均电流。

q: 昨天各厂污泥泵分别运行了多少分钟？（设备数据每分钟一条）

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.running = TRUE AND dr.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND dr.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.running = TRUE AND dr.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND dr.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200
explanation: 按昨天自然日筛选污泥泵设备读数，统计 running=true 的分钟记录数（每分钟一条）得到各厂污泥泵运行分钟数。

q: 11月4日黄官镇1号鼓风机振动第一次超过7.1 mm/s是什么时间？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.vibration_mms AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT r.ts AS 时间, ROUND(CAST(r.vibration_mms AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading AS r JOIN device AS d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts LIMIT 1
explanation: 查询黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机在11月4日当天振动首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。

q: 10月31日那场暴雨的最大降雨强度是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MAX(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(MAX(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计2026年10月31日全天降雨数据中的最大小时降雨强度。

q: 10月31日的降雨从几点开始、几点结束？

attempt_details.sql: WITH rain AS (SELECT ts, rain_mm_h, ts - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts)) * INTERVAL '1 HOUR' AS grp FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND rain_mm_h > 0) SELECT MIN(ts) AS 开始时间, MAX(ts) + INTERVAL '1 HOUR' AS 结束时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 降雨量_mm FROM rain GROUP BY grp ORDER BY 开始时间 LIMIT 200

sql: WITH rain AS (SELECT ts, rain_mm_h, ts - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts)) * INTERVAL '1 HOUR' AS grp FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND rain_mm_h > 0) SELECT MIN(ts) AS 开始时间, MAX(ts) + INTERVAL '1 HOUR' AS 结束时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 降雨量_mm FROM rain GROUP BY grp ORDER BY 开始时间 LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选10月31日降雨强度大于0的时段，按连续小时分组，得到每段降雨的开始时间、结束时间和累计降雨量。

q: 10月31日暴雨当天梁山镇的处理水量比前一天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(日期 AS TEXT) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(vol AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT '10月31日较前一天增加', ROUND(CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-31' THEN vol END) - MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-30' THEN vol END)) AS DECIMAL)) FROM t LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(日期 AS TEXT) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(vol AS DECIMAL)) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT '10月31日较前一天增加', ROUND(CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-31' THEN vol END) - MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-30' THEN vol END)) AS DECIMAL)) FROM t LIMIT 200
explanation: 按日汇总梁山镇污水站 10 月 30 日与 31 日的处理水量（1h 表 inflow 求和），并给出两日差值。

q: 11月4日黄官镇鼓风机故障期间（15点到18点），好氧区溶解氧最低降到多少？（按原始数据）

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' + INTERVAL '15 HOURS' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' + INTERVAL '18 HOURS') SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧最低值, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_2) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧最低值, (SELECT TO_CHAR(ts, 'HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY do_aerobic_1 ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最低值出现时间 FROM t LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' + INTERVAL '15 HOURS' AND r.ts < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' + INTERVAL '18 HOURS') SELECT ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧最低值, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_2) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧最低值, (SELECT TO_CHAR(ts, 'HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY do_aerobic_1 ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最低值出现时间 FROM t LIMIT 200
explanation: 从原始表 plant_reading 取昨天15-18点黄官镇好氧区DO的最小值及出现时刻，用 date_trunc 相对 now() 定位昨天。
columns: 好氧区1号溶解氧最低值
好氧区2号溶解氧最低值

q: 过去7天降雨强度最大的那一天，全区处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: WITH max_rain_day AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS day FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST(m.day AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM max_rain_day AS m JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.hour >= m.day AND h.hour < m.day + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY m.day LIMIT 200

sql: WITH max_rain_day AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS day FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST(m.day AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM max_rain_day AS m JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.hour >= m.day AND h.hour < m.day + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY m.day LIMIT 200
explanation: 先找出过去7天降雨强度最大的自然日，再汇总该日全区所有厂站的处理水量。

q: 11月3日协税镇出水总磷最高达到多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷最高值, COUNT(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY p.name, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.tp_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷最高值, COUNT(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY p.name, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选协税镇污水站 2026-11-03 全天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷峰值。

q: 昨天全区的处理水量比前天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS 前日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 增加量_m3 FROM t LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', h.hour) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND h.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL)) AS 前日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS') AS DATE) THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL)) AS 增加量_m3 FROM t LIMIT 200
explanation: 按自然日汇总最近两天的全区小时处理水量，再相减得到昨日比前日多出的水量。

q: 过去7天平均进水COD高于全区平均水平的厂站有哪些？

attempt_details.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS plant_avg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name), region AS (SELECT AVG(h.cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS') SELECT s.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(s.plant_avg AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(r.region_avg AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区平均COD, ROUND(CAST((s.plant_avg - r.region_avg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 高出值 FROM s CROSS JOIN region AS r WHERE s.plant_avg > r.region_avg ORDER BY s.plant_avg DESC LIMIT 200

sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS plant_avg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name), region AS (SELECT AVG(h.cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS') SELECT s.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(s.plant_avg AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(r.region_avg AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区平均COD, ROUND(CAST((s.plant_avg - r.region_avg) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 高出值 FROM s CROSS JOIN region AS r WHERE s.plant_avg > r.region_avg ORDER BY s.plant_avg DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 分别计算过去7天各厂站平均进水COD与全区总体平均进水COD，筛选高于全区平均的厂站并按均值降序排列。

q: 过去7天中心厂处理水量占全区的百分比

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, p.name, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.kind, p.name) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(CAST(vol AS DECIMAL), 0) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, (SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(vol) AS DECIMAL), 0) FROM t) AS 全区处理水量_m3, (SELECT ROUND(CAST((vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM t) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 占比_百分比 LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, p.name, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.kind, p.name) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(CAST(vol AS DECIMAL), 0) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, (SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(vol) AS DECIMAL), 0) FROM t) AS 全区处理水量_m3, (SELECT ROUND(CAST((vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM t) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 占比_百分比 LIMIT 200
explanation: 按厂站汇总过去7天处理水量，再用中心厂水量除以全区总水量得到占比。

q: 过去7天各厂的总氮去除率（百分比）

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST((1 - AVG(h.tn_out) / AVG(h.tn_in)) AS DECIMAL) * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST((1 - AVG(h.tn_out) / AVG(h.tn_in)) AS DECIMAL) * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.cod_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水COD日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.nh3n_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水氨氮日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.tn_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总氮日均值, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 出水总磷日均值 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选中心厂昨天整天的1小时均值数据，分别计算出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的日均值。

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.cod_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 进水COD平均值, COUNT(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '12 HOURS' GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.nh3n_in) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 平均处理水量_m3h, COUNT(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均进水氨氮_mgL DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 查询最近24小时内 plant_reading_1h 按厂站分组求进水氨氮小时均值的平均值。

q: 昨天全区鼓风机总耗电量和吨水曝气电耗是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, ROUND(CAST(SUM(inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((SUM(blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) LIMIT 200

q: 11月3日协税镇每小时的出水总磷均值

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, TO_CHAR(pr.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 小时, ROUND(CAST(AVG(pr.tp_out) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 出水总磷均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= CAST('2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND pr.hour < CAST('2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name, pr.hour ORDER BY pr.hour LIMIT 200

q: 本周每天中心厂的吨水曝气电耗

attempt_details.sql: SELECT CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', r.hour)) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(吨)", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "鼓风机耗电量(kWh)", ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/吨)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT CAST((DATE_TRUNC('DAY', r.hour)) AS DATE) AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(吨)", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "鼓风机耗电量(kWh)", ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/吨)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
explanation: 按本周自然日汇总中心厂小时数据，用鼓风机耗电量除以处理水量得到吨水曝气电耗。

q: 本周吨水曝气电耗最低的两个厂

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS "厂站", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "曝气耗电量(kWh)", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(m³)", ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(r.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY 4 ASC LIMIT 2

sql: SELECT p.name AS "厂站", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.blower_kw) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "曝气耗电量(kWh)", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "处理水量(m³)", ROUND(CAST((SUM(r.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND r.hour < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(r.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY 4 ASC LIMIT 2
explanation: 按本周小时数据汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水曝气电耗并升序取最低的两个厂。

q: 过去7天有哪些厂出现过出水氨氮超标？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, MAX(r.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, COUNT(*) AS 超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(r.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, MAX(r.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计过去7天内小时出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并按最高值排序。

q: 11月4日黄官镇氨氮超标了几个小时？最高到了多少？

attempt_details.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT id, name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%'), h AS (SELECT pr.plant_id, pr.hour, pr.nh3n_out_max FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND pr.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮_mg_L FROM p LEFT JOIN h ON h.plant_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200

sql: WITH p AS (SELECT id, name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%'), h AS (SELECT pr.plant_id, pr.hour, pr.nh3n_out_max FROM plant_reading_1h AS pr JOIN p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND pr.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, ROUND(CAST(MAX(h.nh3n_out_max) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最高氨氮_mg_L FROM p LEFT JOIN h ON h.plant_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 200
explanation: 筛选黄官镇厂站 11 月 4 日（昨天）的小时数据，用 nh3n_out_max>5 统计超标小时数，并取当日氨氮最高值。

q: 本周全区出水总磷超标的小时数一共有多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "出水总磷超标小时数" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND tp_out_max > 0.5 LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "出水总磷超标小时数" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND tp_out_max > 0.5 LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计本周以来所有厂站小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准 0.5 mg/L 的小时记录数。

q: 昨天每个厂各有几个小时出水不达标？没有超标的厂也要列出来

attempt_details.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, r.hour, (r.cod_out > 50 OR r.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR r.tn_out > 15 OR r.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR r.ss_out > 10) AS exceed FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) SELECT name AS 厂站名称, COUNT(hour) AS 有效小时数, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE exceed) AS 超标小时数, COUNT(hour) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE exceed) AS 达标小时数 FROM h GROUP BY id, name ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

sql: WITH h AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, r.hour, (r.cod_out > 50 OR r.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR r.tn_out > 15 OR r.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR r.ss_out > 10) AS exceed FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ))) SELECT name AS 厂站名称, COUNT(hour) AS 有效小时数, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE exceed) AS 超标小时数, COUNT(hour) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE exceed) AS 达标小时数 FROM h GROUP BY id, name ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
explanation: 以昨天自然日为范围，左连接各厂小时均值数据，按一级A标准（COD>50、氨氮最大值>5、总氮>15、总磷最大值>0.5、SS>10 任一超标）统计每厂超标小时数，无数据/无超标的厂也保留。

q: 过去7天振动值最大的鼓风机是哪台？最大振动是多少？

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, ROUND(CAST(MAX(dr.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动值_mm_s FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.kind ORDER BY MAX(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 5

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, ROUND(CAST(MAX(dr.vibration_mms) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大振动值_mm_s FROM device_reading AS dr JOIN device AS d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.kind ORDER BY MAX(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 5
explanation: 统计最近7天各台鼓风机（device.kind='鼓风机'）振动速度有效值的最大值，按振动值降序排列，取第一行即振动最大的鼓风机。

sql: SELECT MIN(ts) FILTER(WHERE rain_mm_h > 0) AS 降雨开始时间, MAX(ts) FILTER(WHERE rain_mm_h > 0) AS 降雨结束时间, ROUND(CAST(SUM(rain_mm_h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 当日降雨量毫米 FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND ts < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200

q: 10月31日暴雨当天梁山镇的处理水量比前一天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT p.name AS 厂站, CAST((h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name, CAST((h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE)) SELECT 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 当日处理水量, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 前日处理水量, ROUND(CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 增加量 FROM daily GROUP BY 厂站 LIMIT 200

sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT p.name AS 厂站, CAST((h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h AS h JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= CAST('2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND h.hour < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY p.name, CAST((h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE)) SELECT 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 当日处理水量, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 前日处理水量, ROUND(CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN 日期 = CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 增加量 FROM daily GROUP BY 厂站 LIMIT 200
explanation: 按小时表汇总梁山镇污水站10月31日和10月30日的日处理水量，并计算两者差值。

q: 11月4日黄官镇鼓风机故障期间（15点到18点），好氧区溶解氧最低降到多少？（按原始数据）

attempt_details.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.ts < CAST('2026-11-04 18:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT (SELECT name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%' LIMIT 1) AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧1号最低溶解氧_mgL, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_2) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧2号最低溶解氧_mgL, ROUND(CAST(LEAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1), MIN(do_aerobic_2)) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧区最低溶解氧_mgL, (SELECT TO_CHAR(ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 = (SELECT MIN(do_aerobic_1) FROM t) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) AS 好氧1号最低值时刻, COUNT(*) AS 原始数据点数 FROM t LIMIT 200

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= CAST('2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.ts < CAST('2026-11-04 18:00:00+08' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT (SELECT name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%' LIMIT 1) AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧1号最低溶解氧_mgL, ROUND(CAST(MIN(do_aerobic_2) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧2号最低溶解氧_mgL, ROUND(CAST(LEAST(MIN(do_aerobic_1), MIN(do_aerobic_2)) AS DECIMAL), 3) AS 好氧区最低溶解氧_mgL, (SELECT TO_CHAR(ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 = (SELECT MIN(do_aerobic_1) FROM t) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) AS 好氧1号最低值时刻, COUNT(*) AS 原始数据点数 FROM t LIMIT 200
explanation: 按原始 5 秒~1 分钟数据筛选黄官镇污水处理站 11 月 4 日 15:00–18:00 的溶解氧记录，取好氧区 1、2 号 DO 的最小值及最低值出现时刻。

q: 过去7天降雨强度最大的那一天，全区处理了多少水？

attempt_details.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS d, MAX(rain_mm_h) AS max_rain FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND ts < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1), top AS (SELECT d, max_rain FROM daily ORDER BY max_rain DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(top.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(top.max_rain AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM top JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.hour >= top.d AND r.hour < top.d + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY top.d, top.max_rain LIMIT 200

sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ts) AS d, MAX(rain_mm_h) AS max_rain FROM weather WHERE ts >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND ts < CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY 1), top AS (SELECT d, max_rain FROM daily ORDER BY max_rain DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(top.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, ROUND(CAST(top.max_rain AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h, ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM top JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.hour >= top.d AND r.hour < top.d + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY top.d, top.max_rain LIMIT 200
explanation: 先在最近7天按自然日取气象数据最大降雨强度找出雨强最大的一天，再汇总该天各厂站小时处理水量得到全区处理水量。
