q: 昨天全区的处理水量比前天多了多少立方米？

attempt_details.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) THEN '昨天' WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN '前天' END AS 日期, SUM(inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 昨日处理水量, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 前日处理水量, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 增加水量 FROM d LIMIT 200

sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) THEN '昨天' WHEN hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' THEN '前天' END AS 日期, SUM(inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '2 DAYS' AND hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 昨日处理水量, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 前日处理水量, ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END)) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS 增加水量 FROM d LIMIT 200
explanation: 按自然日汇总全区各厂站 plant_reading_1h 的处理水量，计算昨天与前天的差值。

q: 过去7天平均进水COD高于全区平均水平的厂站有哪些？

attempt_details.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name), region AS (SELECT AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_all FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(s.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(r.avg_all AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM stats AS s CROSS JOIN region AS r WHERE s.avg_cod > r.avg_all ORDER BY s.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200

sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant AS p JOIN plant_reading_1h AS h ON h.plant_id = p.id WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name), region AS (SELECT AVG(h.cod_in) AS avg_all FROM plant_reading_1h AS h WHERE h.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.name AS 厂站, ROUND(CAST(s.avg_cod AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 平均进水COD, ROUND(CAST(r.avg_all AS DECIMAL), 2) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM stats AS s CROSS JOIN region AS r WHERE s.avg_cod > r.avg_all ORDER BY s.avg_cod DESC LIMIT 200
explanation: 先按厂站统计过去7天小时表中进水COD均值，再计算全区同期平均进水COD，筛选出高于全区平均值的厂站。

q: 过去7天中心厂处理水量占全区的百分比

attempt_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "中心厂处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "全区处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "占比_百分比" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "中心厂处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST(SUM(r.inflow_m3h) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "全区处理水量_m3", ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "占比_百分比" FROM plant_reading_1h AS r JOIN plant AS p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AND r.hour <= CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) LIMIT 200
explanation: 统计过去7天各厂站小时处理水量，按中心厂与全区汇总后计算中心厂处理水量占全区百分比。

q: 过去7天各厂的总氮去除率（百分比）

q: 昨天各厂的实际处理水量占设计规模的负荷率（百分比）

attempt_details.sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((COALESCE(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) / p.capacity_m3d * 100) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY 负荷率_百分比 DESC LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, ROUND(CAST((COALESCE(SUM(r.inflow_m3h), 0) / p.capacity_m3d * 100) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant AS p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h AS r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND r.hour < DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2026-11-05T12:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY 负荷率_百分比 DESC LIMIT 200
